retention.active: until explicit file/product/owning household deletion or app account deletion
retention.subscriptionExpiry: no automatic erasure; retained reading, download and deletion; new uploads require verified rights
retention.membershipRemoval: revoke access immediately; does not alone erase another uploader's files
retention.fileDeletion: block reads immediately on accepted deletion; proposed physical removal target within 30 days after successful acceptance
retention.appDeletion: block app account writes/reads at accepted closure; purge owned live objects with durable retry; proposed physical removal target within 30 days
retention.backup: public wording blocked until provider backup inventory and expiry are confirmed
retention.outage: show pending deletion and allow status reread; never claim erasure before verified completion
retention.basicRecords: subscription expiry does not erase products, tasks or history; free viewing/export remain
